method: Additive potential against supported accepted concepts. Member rows overlap; do not sum as unique gains.
source_policy: Source IPA only counts as supplied. Resegmented spelling is orthographic potential, never supported evidence.
limitations: Raw upstream mappings require sense review. Same Glottocode does not certify sample identity. Primary-source profile recovery is outside this alternatives report.
known_holds: Includes Nyagrong-Minyaɡ/Muya identity mismatch and other held notation/sense cases. Raw ceilings overlap and are not admissions. Primary-source profile recovery and beyond-core vocabulary are not measured by this screen.
